home.cold.comment: Cold home loads the full ordered app module graph plus digest preview awareness on boot (aPreview). Digest-decouple train base measured ~436015 gzip wire bytes p95 in CI. T3 attachment related-notices adds ~0.8–1.2 KB gzip on the always-loaded path (alerts/routing/i18n/index chrome only); the related JSON artifact and client helper load only on attachment-bearing notice detail, not home cold. Two landed features re-baselined the ceiling from 440000 to 445000: the property-lens filter template (its inline lens/cluster CSS ships in home index.html) and the design-language token sheet (brand.css, loaded on every page). Measured p95 ~442801 after both; 445000 was the settled main ceiling. This PR deliberately raises to 475000: rules association monitor pack adds always-loaded templates registry + rules action-band/participation/blurb modules, Alerts template chrome, and i18n keys (CI 20-sample p95 measured 471794 gzip wireBytes on tip 01c18c62). Budget 475000 clears that measurement with small headroom without masking a sudden step. Ratchet target: under 435000 after a home-path load split that defers alerts preview awareness.

contracts.keyword-housing.comment: The 20-sample pre-change p95 measured 212 ms; 225 ms prevents regression. Ratchet target: 200 ms.
